lines.t: Verse 1
I heard You say, “Come to Me,
All who are weary and burdened, I’ll give you peace
Take My yoke, learn from Me
Gentle and humble, rest for your soul when you’re weak
For My yoke is easy, My burden is light”*
You reached out Your hand and said,
“The healthy don’t need a physician instead
I came for the sick, not the righteous ahead
But sinners in need of repentance”—the ones You never forget
Verse 2
In the beginning You rescued me
I knew I was broken, I knew I was weak
But that was years ago, honestly
I thought I’d be farther than where I’m still at
I knew I was a sinner in need of Your grace
I found You once—why’m I in the same place?
You say, “My grace is sufficient for you
My strength is perfected in weakness” too
But oh Lord, I’m asking You—
Why do these fleshly desires still pull me through?
Chorus
Shouldn’t I be farther by now?
I know You saved me, I know You pulled me out
I still feel bound by these chains that You say are only threads
Shouldn’t I be farther by now?
Past these desires weighing me down
I trust Your Word, I just don’t know how
I’m still in need of rescue somehow
Verse 3
I was a sheep, battered on every side
You stepped in once, pulled me out alive
Your roar drove the wolves away from me
I stood in the light, I was finally free
But now I’m back in that familiar place
I’m still standing, but I’m asking again—
Lord, why do I need to hear Your roar like then
Bridge
If You already saved me once
Why do I need Your rescue again?
If You already saved me once
Why do I need Your rescue again?
If You already called me Yours
Why do I need Your roar again?
Final Chorus
Shouldn’t I be farther by now?
Still fighting battles I should’ve outgrown
Yet through it all, somehow You’re still here
Calling my eyes back onto You
Asking me to partake of You
As more of You rushes in
And less of me remains
Outro
Still in need
Still being changed
Still Yours
Still saved
But shouldn't I be
Farther than me
